memory: Mirror Cartographer may present distinct deterministic productions while preserving one continuity substrate. That substrate is transferable only as a bounded public abstraction bound to immutable production evidence; it is not copied private source material, not proof of runtime activation, and not evidence that adjacent productions executed.

claims.claim: The retained Vercel handoff contract requires adjacent hourly receipts, exact source-commit agreement, exact repertory-digest agreement, privacy_class public_abstract, a 4096-byte ceiling, and rejection of named private-source fields.
The handoff explicitly sets runtime_activation_claimed, deployment_claimed, browser_execution_claimed, and audio_claimed to false and marks the envelope reversible.
Continuity is modeled as an identity-bearing state transition across productions, not as persistence of one visual surface and not as replication of originating source material.
Future continuity envelopes should carry claim-state labels and immutable provenance locators for every retained public abstraction before they are admitted into the project knowledge graph.
claims.falsification_route: Demonstrate a retained continuity envelope that remains privacy-safe, provenance-preserving, and unambiguous without claim-state labels or immutable source locators.

claims.claim: Continuity requires exposing prior chat text, medical records, private source excerpts, or credentials to the next production.
The originating decision or lexicon source that first defined the project-wide phrase one underlying continuity state has not been located in immutable repository history during this bounded run.
claims.falsification_route: Locate the earliest immutable decision log, lexicon, project document, or chat-derived provenance object assigning that phrase and semantic role.

contradictions_resolved.tension: Hourly productions are distinct versus the system preserves one continuity state.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Distinct presentation and persistent identity are separate layers. Production identity may change each hour while a bounded, digest-bound public continuity abstraction crosses the boundary.

contradictions_resolved.tension: A handoff exists versus peers or runtime executed.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: The retained contract is operations-only evidence and explicitly denies activation, deployment, browser, and audio claims. Existence of an envelope cannot prove execution.
